en.headline: SFC approves six share registrars for paperless securities market
en.dek: The approvals take effect when the uncertificated securities market launches on 16 November, with two firms cleared to offer conversion and transfer services from day one.
body: The Securities and Futures Commission said on Monday it had approved six companies as approved securities registrars under the uncertificated securities market regime that begins on 16 November.

The six are Boardroom Share Registrars (HK) Limited, Computershare Hong Kong Investor Services Limited, Share Registrars Limited, Hong Kong Managers and Secretaries Limited, Tricor Investor Services Limited and Union Registrars Limited. All may continue their existing registrar services.

Computershare and Tricor have also been approved to provide services specific to the uncertificated market, including the systems used to prove and transfer legal ownership of securities and to convert holdings from paper to electronic form. The commission said they would be the first two able to offer those services, and that it would consider further applications in due course.

Under the new rules, listed issuers of prescribed securities must appoint an approved registrar at all times to maintain their holder registers. New listings after the launch date must be issued in uncertificated form from the outset, while existing issuers have five years to join the system.

zh.headline: 證監會核准六家證券登記機構 無紙市場下月實施
zh.dek: 核准自11月16日無紙證券市場制度實施起生效，其中兩家已獲准提供紙本轉無紙及相關轉讓服務。
body: 證券及期貨事務監察委員會周一表示，已核准六家公司作為核准證券登記機構，有關核准將於無紙證券市場制度在11月16日實施時生效。
六家機構分別為寶德隆證券登記有限公司、香港中央證券登記有限公司、證券登記有限公司、香港經理秘書有限公司、卓佳證券登記有限公司及聯合證券登記有限公司。證監會指，它們均獲准繼續提供現有的證券登記服務。
其中香港中央證券登記及卓佳已獲核准提供與無紙證券市場相關的服務，包括證明及轉讓證券法定所有權的系統，以及將證券由紙本形式轉換成無紙形式。證監會表示，這兩家是首批可提供這類服務的機構，並會適時審閱其他申請。
制度實施後，上市發行人須在任何時刻委任核准證券登記機構維持持有人登記冊。11月16日後新上市的訂明證券須自上市起以無紙形式發行，現有發行人則須在五年內參與新制度。
